name: Valiant
lore: A light warship for the upper air, little more than a hull, a drive and one long rail gun. The yards turn them out faster than frigates, and send them out in threes.

weapons.name: Long Rail Cannon
weapons.lore: The Resolute's turret gun drawn out to twice its length: it charges, then fires a slug no other tech 2 gun can match for reach.

weapons.name: AA Rotary Cannon
weapons.lore: A six-barrel rotary gun astern, for the fighters that come for the ship. It needs a moment to spin up.
